## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. # pr-1390: feat(1079): SDK slice 4 — HostExtensionApi: declared builder-gated extensions (E6/E7/E8)

## Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1390
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1390
- **Title**: feat(1079): SDK slice 4 — HostExtensionApi: declared builder-gated extensions (E6/E7/E8)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1079-sdk-host-slice4` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1053
- **Deletions**: -327
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T17:27:38Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T19:39:20Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

- **PR #**: 1390
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1390
- **Title**: feat(1079): SDK slice 4 — HostExtensionApi: declared builder-gated extensions (E6/E7/E8)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1079-sdk-host-slice4` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1053
- **Deletions**: -327
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T17:27:38Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T19:39:20Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. - **Updated**: 2026-10-07T19:39:20Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1079-sdk-host-slice4` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1053
- **Deletions**: -327
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T17:27:38Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T19:39:20Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1390
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1390
- **Title**: feat(1079): SDK slice 4 — HostExtensionApi: declared builder-gated extensions (E6/E7/E8)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1079-sdk-host-slice4` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1053
- **Deletions**: -327
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T17:27:38Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T19:39:20Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1390
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1390
- **Title**: feat(1079): SDK slice 4 — HostExtensionApi: declared builder-gated extensions (E6/E7/E8)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1079-sdk-host-slice4` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1053
- **Deletions**: -327
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T17:27:38Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T19:39:20Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1390
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1390
- **Title**: feat(1079): SDK slice 4 — HostExtensionApi: declared builder-gated extensions (E6/E7/E8)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1079-sdk-host-slice4` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1053
- **Deletions**: -327
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T17:27:38Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T19:39:20Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

**99/99 tests pass** and `dart analyze` is clean on the PR files. This confirms the author's round-2 claims:
- The blocking red suite is fixed (builder-level `_wireFabric` null fix holds).
- The hostExtensionApi cell is enforced + pinned.
- All three suggestions applied.

Now let me do the exhaustive single-pass review on the current head. Let me re-check remaining areas:

1. The `_wireFabric` nullable return — check the full function signature and call site for correctness.
2. Check the AGENTS.md change.
3. Check `bin/fah.dart` zone handler — does `_fail` exist in fah_runapp.dart and is it Never?
4. Look for any remaining issues: e.g., `_rejectToolIdCollisions` map iteration order — Dart map literal preserves insertion order, fine.
5. Check `WiredAgentCore.extensions` — extension tools in `tools` but NOT in `sdkTools`. The doc comment for `tools` says "Child-safe: the task executor strips only `task` itself". Extension tools ride the pool — pinned by test.
6. Potential issue: `_wireExtensions` is called BEFORE `_buildCoreTools` and before task complex — the E7 collision check runs after the task complex. But the extension tools are already spliced into `tools` which feeds `taskComplex` (child pool). If a collision existed between extension tool and task surface tool, the task complex would be assembled with the colliding tool in the pool before E7 throws — but E7 throws right after, so nothing reaches a registry. Fine ("BEFORE anything reaches a registry").
7. One more check: `extensionCell as HiddenCapability` — for a capability with no transports, can the plan entry ever be `CapabilityTransportState`-derived WiredCapability? planFor returns WiredCapability or HiddenCapability only. Safe.

8. Check `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — the try/catch placement. `cli = AgentCli(...)` wrapped in `on ConfigException catch (error) { _fail(error.message); }`. `_fail` is Never → definite assignment of `cli` OK (author claimed flow analysis works). The earlier `attachSecretRedactor(cli.agent, redactor)` after the try — fine.

But wait — there's a subtle issue with the try/catch: `onSecretStored`/`onProviderChanged` closures reference `cli` — those are inside the constructor argument, so `cli` is being assigned... those closures run later at runtime (after assignment). Fine — that pattern existed before.

9. Let me check `_fail` definition in fah_runapp.dart.

10. Check the AGENTS.md diff hunk.

11. Check `HostExtension` import of `builtInProfiles` from `host_wiring_builder.dart` — that's a big file with the catalog; importing `show builtInProfiles` keeps it clean. OK.

12. Consider: `HostExtension` constructor validation — `profileStates` may contain custom profile keys with `CapabilityTransportState` — rejected. Blank-name tools rejected. Duplicate tool ids rejected. What about tool ids colliding with task surface names at CONSTRUCTION time? No — that's wire-time (E7). OK.

13. What about `WiredHostExtension` — `const` constructor with `List<AgentTool> tools` — no unmodifiable there, but `_wireExtensions` passes `List.unmodifiable(extension.tools)` or `const []`. OK.

14. Check `host_agent_wiring.dart` — `AgentCoreServices.extensions` default `const []`. The migration from `hostTools` — check there are no other constructor callers with `hostTools:`. Already grepped: no `hostTools:` callers remain (only a comment reference).

15. Check flutter_app — does flutter_app use AgentCoreServices with hostTools? The grep covered flutter_app/lib and found nothing. OK.

16. Check `extension` in `WiredAgentCore` — is it exposed via the barrel? `host_extension_api.dart` is exported; `WiredAgentCore` is in host_agent_wiring.dart which is exported. OK.

17. Bench/ or other hosts (yoclip?) using wireAgentCore — grep for wireAgentCore callers to ensure none pass hostTools.

Let me also check that the E7 check doesn't break the existing `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` path — that's registry-level, not builder-level. Fine.

18. One more consideration — `HostExtension` uses `builtInProfiles.keys` validation. `builtInProfiles` has 7 entries (cli, macos, ios, android, web, ...)? The test says "All seven built-in profiles". Fine.

19. The AC9 test uses `sessionEnvVars: () => {}` and `sandbox: const SandboxServices()` — byte-identity checks.

20. `bin/fah.dart` — the entry point. When AgentCli constructor throws ConfigException now caught in _runApp → _fail. Check _fail prints to stderr and exits with code. Let me verify.

21. Also examine the `dart_test.yaml` / CI workflow to see what runs on PRs — `test/hosts` is in CI.

22. Potential new finding candidates:
   a. `_rejectToolIdCollisions` — the `claim` function is defined but the map iteration could be simplified; trivial.
   b. `WiredHostExtension.tools` for the wired case is `List.unmodifiable(extension.tools)` — but `HostExtension.tools` is ALREADY unmodifiable at construction. Double-wrapping — harmless, defensive.
   c. In the cell-off branch, `extensionCell as HiddenCapability` — could instead pattern match. Minor style.
   d. `AgentCli` — the `cli-plugins` extension: if `pluginTools` is empty, extension still declared and on → wires zero tools. WiredHostExtension with empty tools, `isHidden == false`. Harmless.
   e. What about `name: 'cli-plugins'` colliding with a user-declared extension of the same name? Collision check is on TOOL ids, not extension names. Two extensions with the same name but different tools — the E7 message would name them identically ("extension "cli-plugins""), confusing but not a bug. Hmm — is duplicate extension NAME checked? No! Two extensions can both be named 'cli-plugins'. The E7 report names registrants by extension name — duplicates would produce ambiguous reports. Minor suggestion-level gap. Actually wait — in AgentCli, the host declares 'cli-plugins' with plugin tools. A third party can't add more extensions to AgentCli's services (single extension list). But the API allows two extensions with the same name — no constructor check. The collision error message would say both are 'extension "x"'. It names the tool id too, so it's still actionable. Suggestion-level at most. Hmm, is it worth flagging? The registration contract says "Registrant id — E7 collision reports name both sides". Duplicate registrant ids undermine that. I'd flag as SUGGESTION.

   f. `HostExtension` empty name check uses `name.trim().isEmpty` but stores the raw `name` (could be ' yoclip ') — E7 messages would carry the whitespace. Trivial.

   g. `_wireExtensions` switch wildcard `_ =>` — covers CapabilityOnState only (transport states rejected at construction). Could be explicit `CapabilityOnState()`. Trivial style; the wildcard is exhaustive-safe due to sealed hierarchy.

   h. Security: no secrets in the diff (apiKey redacted in diff already). The extension surface is additive-only, E7 protects core tools. ConfigException → _fail path. No injection risks — tool ids go into registry and messages, not shells.

   i. AGENTS.md update — required by AC8. Present.

   j. Test coverage: E6 (4 rejection tests + 1 construct), E7 (3 collision tests), E8 (4 tests incl. cell-off), AC9 (2 tests). Good coverage. Missing: no test for the `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field when there are NO extensions (empty list) — trivial, covered by other wiring tests.

   k. One more: `hiddenReason: (extensionCell as HiddenCapability).reason` — the reason could be blank? HostCapabilityProfile validation requires non-blank reasons for off states (E2). Let me verify: `_requireComplete` etc. — profile construction rejects blank reasons ("an undeclared capability, an empty/blank reason"). Yes.

   l. In `_wireFabric` — new comment documents the null return. The caller: `final fabricAssembly = _wireFabric(plan: plan, services: services);` then `fabric: fabricAssembly?.fabric`. What about `fileFabric` and `messagesRoot` usages? Let me check the call site fully to make sure nothing else force-unwraps.

Let me check these remaining items.

## PR Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

# pr-1390: feat(1079): SDK slice 4 — HostExtensionApi: declared builder-gated extensions (E6/E7/E8)

## Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

# pr-1390: feat(1079): SDK slice 4 — HostExtensionApi: declared builder-gated extensions (E6/E7/E8)

## Description

Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.
- **CLI migration**: `AgentCli` passes its plugin tools as a declared `cli-plugins` extension — `on` for the CLI profile, `off(reason)` for the other six (a host adopting another profile declares its own extensions). Registry order is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md**: capability rules extended with the extension contract (E6/E7/E8 + additive-only), per AC8.

## Delivered vs remaining slices

| Slice | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — profiles + builder foundation | ✅ #1091 |
| 2 — live wiring (`wireAgentCore`); CLI converts | ✅ #1230 |
| 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex | ✅ #1313 |
| 4 — HostExtensionApi: E6 matrix at birth, E7 build-time collisions, E8 hiding, AC9 additive-only pin | **this PR** |
| 5 — flutter_app adopts the builder (AC1 second half: app hand-wiring deleted to profile + platform services) | remaining |
| 6 — IT-5 record-level byte parity (JSONL kinds/compaction/memory record diff for a registered extension host, the YoClip scenario end-to-end) | remaining |
| 7 — extension prompt-sections/bridges registration; #1077/#1078 suites rewired through the builder (AC5) | remaining |

## Local gate disclosure (honest)

Local `dart` is the Flutter-cask wrapper (its engine-stamp updater can't write the shared cache), and the raw dart-sdk run was **SIGKILLed by the host guard (exit 137) on the first attempt** — per lane policy I did not retry. Verification here is static 1:1: every referenced symbol/field checked against source (`CapabilityState` hierarchy, `builtInProfiles`, `TaskToolConfig.childTools`, `CapabilityPlanEntry`, exception contracts), no `hostTools` callers remain, fixture and imports migrated. **CI is the real gate** — analyze + the extended `test/hosts/` matrix (new `host_extension_api_test.dart`: E6 construction rejections, E7 collision naming, E8 hiding/reason surfacing, AC9 core-identity and child-pool pins) run there.

Actually wait — in AgentCli, the host declares 'cli-plugins' with plugin tools. A third party can't add more extensions to AgentCli's services (single extension list). But the API allows two extensions with the same name — no constructor check. The collision error message would say both are 'extension "x"'. It names the tool id too, so it's still actionable. Suggestion-level at most. Hmm, is it worth flagging? The registration contract says "Registrant id — E7 collision reports name both sides". Duplicate registrant ids undermine that. I'd flag as SUGGESTION.

What about `fileFabric` and `messagesRoot` usages? Let me check the call site fully to make sure nothing else force-unwraps.

new file mode 100644
index 000000000..25a7e0171
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,139 @@
+/// The declared host-extension surface (issue #1079 component 4 —
+/// `HostExtensionApi`): the sanctioned way a host adds what the SDK does
+/// not have — its own tools — THROUGH the builder, with the capability
+/// matrix declared at birth.
+///
+/// A [HostExtension] is a named registrant's contribution: the tools it
+/// contributes plus an explicit state for every profile the host can
+/// wire. The builder (lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart) enforces the
+/// three extension invariants:
+///
+/// - **E6 — declared at birth**: every built-in profile MUST have an
+///   explicit state (`on` / `off(reason)`); there is no implicit default.
+///   A state for a custom profile is optional at construction but
+///   required at wire time for any profile the host actually wires.
+/// - **E7 — collisions rejected at build time**: an extension tool id
+///   colliding with the SDK core, the gated task surface, or another
+///   extension throws [HostWiringException] naming both registrants. (A
+///   tool id colliding with a CORE tool would silently override SDK
+///   behavior — the one thing this API must never do — so the loud check
+///   lives in the builder, not the replace-and-note [ToolRegistry], whose
+///   leniency is the child-pool contract, issue #862.)
+/// - **E8 — off means hidden with a reason**: on a profile whose state is
+///   `off`, the extension's tools never reach the registry and the off
+///   reason surfaces through [WiredAgentCore.extensions] for the host's
+///   UI — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
+///
+/// **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5):** the type carries tools and declarations,
+/// nothing else — there is no member that could override a core behavior
+/// (memory, context management, compaction, the JSONL tool session,
+/// trajectory are SDK invariants). The only route to "replace" a core
+/// tool is a colliding id, and E7 rejects it at build time.
+///
+/// Pure Dart: no `dart:io`.
+library;
+
+import '../agent/agent_tool.dart';
+import 'host_capability_profile.dart';
+import 'host_wiring_builder.dart' show builtInProfiles;
+
+/// A host's declared extension: named tools + an explicit per-profile
+/// matrix state (E6).
+final class HostExtension {
+  /// Registrant id — E7 collision reports name both sides; keep it the
+  /// thing a host user would recognize (`cli-plugins`, `yoclip`).
+  final String name;
+
+  /// The tools contributed on profiles where the extension is `on`.
+  final List<AgentTool> tools;
+
+  /// The matrix declaration: profile name → state. Every built-in profile
+  /// (the keys of `builtInProfiles`) MUST be present — E6, no implicit
+  /// default. Extra keys are custom profiles; they are validated at wire
+  /// time (a state must exist for whatever the host actually wires).
+  final Map<String, CapabilityState> profileStates;
+
+  /// Validates and builds. Throws [HostProfileViolation] on an E6 gap
+  /// (missing built-in profile, blank reason, a transport state — tool
+  /// extensions have no transport dimension), an empty name, or an
+  /// empty/duplicate tool id.
+  HostExtension({
+    required this.name,
+    List<AgentTool> tools = const [],
+    required Map<String, CapabilityState> profileStates,
+  }) : tools = List.unmodifiable(tools),
+       profileStates = Map.unmodifiable(profileStates) {
+    if (name.trim().isEmpty) {
+      throw const HostProfileViolation(
+        'HostExtension name must not be blank (E7 names registrants — '
+        'they need a real id).',
+      );
+    }
+    final missing = builtInProfiles.keys
+        .where((profile) => !profileStates.containsKey(profile))
+        .toList();
+    if (missing.isNotEmpty) {
+      throw HostProfileViolation(
+        'HostExtension "$name" declares no state for built-in profile(s) '
+        '${missing.map((m) => '"$m"').join(', ')} — declare every built-in '
+        'profile explicitly (E6: there is no implicit default).',
+      );
+    }
+    for (final entry in profileStates.entries) {
+      if (entry.value is CapabilityTransportState) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" declares a transport state for profile '
+          '"${entry.key}" — tool extensions have no transport dimension; '
+          'declare on or off(reason).',
+        );
+      }
+      if (entry.value.reason case final reason? when reason.trim().isEmpty) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" is off on "${entry.key}" without a reason '
+          '— off is never silent (E8).',
+        );
+      }
+    }
+    final seen = <String>{};
+    for (final tool in tools) {
+      if (tool.name.trim().isEmpty) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" contributes a tool with a blank id.',
+        );
+      }
+      if (!seen.add(tool.name)) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" contributes "${tool.name}" twice — the '
+          'builder rejects duplicate ids at build time (E7).',
+        );
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// The declared state for [profileName], or null when the profile is a
+  /// custom one this extension does not declare (validated at wire time).

@@ -0,0 +1,139 @@
+/// The declared host-extension surface (issue #1079 component 4 —
+/// `HostExtensionApi`): the sanctioned way a host adds what the SDK does
+/// not have — its own tools — THROUGH the builder, with the capability
+/// matrix declared at birth.
+///
+/// A [HostExtension] is a named registrant's contribution: the tools it
+/// contributes plus an explicit state for every profile the host can
+/// wire. The builder (lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart) enforces the
+/// three extension invariants:
+///
+/// - **E6 — declared at birth**: every built-in profile MUST have an
+///   explicit state (`on` / `off(reason)`); there is no implicit default.
+///   A state for a custom profile is optional at construction but
+///   required at wire time for any profile the host actually wires.
+/// - **E7 — collisions rejected at build time**: an extension tool id
+///   colliding with the SDK core, the gated task surface, or another
+///   extension throws [HostWiringException] naming both registrants. (A
+///   tool id colliding with a CORE tool would silently override SDK
+///   behavior — the one thing this API must never do — so the loud check
+///   lives in the builder, not the replace-and-note [ToolRegistry], whose
+///   leniency is the child-pool contract, issue #862.)
+/// - **E8 — off means hidden with a reason**: on a profile whose state is
+///   `off`, the extension's tools never reach the registry and the off
+///   reason surfaces through [WiredAgentCore.extensions] for the host's
+///   UI — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
+///
+/// **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5):** the type carries tools and declarations,
+/// nothing else — there is no member that could override a core behavior
+/// (memory, context management, compaction, the JSONL tool session,
+/// trajectory are SDK invariants). The only route to "replace" a core
+/// tool is a colliding id, and E7 rejects it at build time.
+///
+/// Pure Dart: no `dart:io`.
+library;
+
+import '../agent/agent_tool.dart';
+import 'host_capability_profile.dart';
+import 'host_wiring_builder.dart' show builtInProfiles;
+
+/// A host's declared extension: named tools + an explicit per-profile
+/// matrix state (E6).
+final class HostExtension {
+  /// Registrant id — E7 collision reports name both sides; keep it the
+  /// thing a host user would recognize (`cli-plugins`, `yoclip`).
+  final String name;
+
+  /// The tools contributed on profiles where the extension is `on`.
+  final List<AgentTool> tools;
+
+  /// The matrix declaration: profile name → state. Every built-in profile
+  /// (the keys of `builtInProfiles`) MUST be present — E6, no implicit
+  /// default. Extra keys are custom profiles; they are validated at wire
+  /// time (a state must exist for whatever the host actually wires).
+  final Map<String, CapabilityState> profileStates;
+
+  /// Validates and builds. Throws [HostProfileViolation] on an E6 gap
+  /// (missing built-in profile, blank reason, a transport state — tool
+  /// extensions have no transport dimension), an empty name, or an
+  /// empty/duplicate tool id.
+  HostExtension({
+    required this.name,
+    List<AgentTool> tools = const [],
+    required Map<String, CapabilityState> profileStates,
+  }) : tools = List.unmodifiable(tools),
+       profileStates = Map.unmodifiable(profileStates) {
+    if (name.trim().isEmpty) {
+      throw const HostProfileViolation(
+        'HostExtension name must not be blank (E7 names registrants — '
+        'they need a real id).',
+      );
+    }
+    final missing = builtInProfiles.keys
+        .where((profile) => !profileStates.containsKey(profile))
+        .toList();
+    if (missing.isNotEmpty) {
+      throw HostProfileViolation(
+        'HostExtension "$name" declares no state for built-in profile(s) '
+        '${missing.map((m) => '"$m"').join(', ')} — declare every built-in '
+        'profile explicitly (E6: there is no implicit default).',
+      );
+    }
+    for (final entry in profileStates.entries) {
+      if (entry.value is CapabilityTransportState) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" declares a transport state for profile '
+          '"${entry.key}" — tool extensions have no transport dimension; '
+          'declare on or off(reason).',
+        );
+      }
+      if (entry.value.reason case final reason? when reason.trim().isEmpty) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" is off on "${entry.key}" without a reason '
+          '— off is never silent (E8).',
+        );
+      }
+    }
+    final seen = <String>{};
+    for (final tool in tools) {
+      if (tool.name.trim().isEmpty) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" contributes a tool with a blank id.',
+        );
+      }
+      if (!seen.add(tool.name)) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" contributes "${tool.name}" twice — the '
+          'builder rejects duplicate ids at build time (E7).',
+        );
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// The declared state for [profileName], or null when the profile is a
+  /// custom one this extension does not declare (validated at wire time).

{
  "key": "pr-1390",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "feat(1079): SDK slice 4 — HostExtensionApi: declared builder-gated extensions (E6/E7/E8)",
    "description": "Part of #1079 (epic slice — remaining slices stay on the GOAL; no Closes).

## What landed (slice 4 — issue component 4, `HostExtensionApi`)

Host extensions become **declared, builder-gated surface** instead of a raw tool list:

- **New** `lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart` — `HostExtension` (named registrant: tools + explicit state for **every built-in profile at birth**, E6 — no implicit default; a transport state or blank off-reason is rejected; custom-profile states validate at wire time) and `WiredHostExtension` (per-extension outcome: wired tools, or the off reason, E8).
- **Builder gating** in `wireAgentCore` (`host_agent_wiring.dart`): extension tools splice after the SDK core in the canonical tail position; **E7** — tool-id collisions across the SDK core / gated task surface / extensions throw `HostWiringException` at build time naming both registrants. The loud check lives in the builder, not `ToolRegistry` (whose replace-and-note leniency stays for the child-pool contract, #862, and the per-run `buildAgentStack(additionalTools:)` surface).
- **E8**: a profile-off extension contributes no tools and surfaces its reason on the new `WiredAgentCore.extensions` field — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
- **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5)**: the extension surface carries tools + declarations, nothing else; the only route to "replace" a core tool is a colliding id and E7 slams it (pinned by test). Core tools, env chain and per-capability plan are byte-identical with and without an extension (pinned by test), and extension tools ride the child tool pool like the core surface.

+/// The declared host-extension surface (issue #1079 component 4 —
+/// `HostExtensionApi`): the sanctioned way a host adds what the SDK does
+/// not have — its own tools — THROUGH the builder, with the capability
+/// matrix declared at birth.
+///
+/// A [HostExtension] is a named registrant's contribution: the tools it
+/// contributes plus an explicit state for every profile the host can
+/// wire. The builder (lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart) enforces the
+/// three extension invariants:
+///
+/// - **E6 — declared at birth**: every built-in profile MUST have an
+///   explicit state (`on` / `off(reason)`); there is no implicit default.
+///   A state for a custom profile is optional at construction but
+///   required at wire time for any profile the host actually wires.
+/// - **E7 — collisions rejected at build time**: an extension tool id
+///   colliding with the SDK core, the gated task surface, or another
+///   extension throws [HostWiringException] naming both registrants. (A
+///   tool id colliding with a CORE tool would silently override SDK
+///   behavior — the one thing this API must never do — so the loud check
+///   lives in the builder, not the replace-and-note [ToolRegistry], whose
+///   leniency is the child-pool contract, issue #862.)
+/// - **E8 — off means hidden with a reason**: on a profile whose state is
+///   `off`, the extension's tools never reach the registry and the off
+///   reason surfaces through [WiredAgentCore.extensions] for the host's
+///   UI — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
+///
+/// **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5):** the type carries tools and declarations,
+/// nothing else — there is no member that could override a core behavior
+/// (memory, context management, compaction, the JSONL tool session,
+/// trajectory are SDK invariants). The only route to "replace" a core
+/// tool is a colliding id, and E7 rejects it at build time.
+///
+/// Pure Dart: no `dart:io`.
+library;
+
+import '../agent/agent_tool.dart';
+import 'host_capability_profile.dart';
+import 'host_wiring_builder.dart' show builtInProfiles;
+
+/// A host's declared extension: named tools + an explicit per-profile
+/// matrix state (E6).
+final class HostExtension {
+  /// Registrant id — E7 collision reports name both sides; keep it the
+  /// thing a host user would recognize (`cli-plugins`, `yoclip`).
+  final String name;
+
+  /// The tools contributed on profiles where the extension is `on`.
+  final List<AgentTool> tools;
+
+  /// The matrix declaration: profile name → state. Every built-in profile
+  /// (the keys of `builtInProfiles`) MUST be present — E6, no implicit
+  /// default. Extra keys are custom profiles; they are validated at wire
+  /// time (a state must exist for whatever the host actually wires).
+  final Map<String, CapabilityState> profileStates;
+
+  /// Validates and builds. Throws [HostProfileViolation] on an E6 gap
+  /// (missing built-in profile, blank reason, a transport state — tool
+  /// extensions have no transport dimension), an empty name, or an
+  /// empty/duplicate tool id.
+  HostExtension({
+    required this.name,
+    List<AgentTool> tools = const [],
+    required Map<String, CapabilityState> profileStates,
+  }) : tools = List.unmodifiable(tools),
+       profileStates = Map.unmodifiable(profileStates) {
+    if (name.trim().isEmpty) {
+      throw const HostProfileViolation(
+        'HostExtension name must not be blank (E7 names registrants — '
+        'they need a real id).',
+      );
+    }
+    final missing = builtInProfiles.keys
+        .where((profile) => !profileStates.containsKey(profile))
+        .toList();
+    if (missing.isNotEmpty) {
+      throw HostProfileViolation(
+        'HostExtension "$name" declares no state for built-in profile(s) '
+        '${missing.map((m) => '"$m"').join(', ')} — declare every built-in '
+        'profile explicitly (E6: there is no implicit default).',
+      );
+    }
+    for (final entry in profileStates.entries) {
+      if (entry.value is CapabilityTransportState) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" declares a transport state for profile '
+          '"${entry.key}" — tool extensions have no transport dimension; '
+          'declare on or off(reason).',
+        );
+      }
+      if (entry.value.reason case final reason? when reason.trim().isEmpty) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" is off on "${entry.key}" without a reason '
+          '— off is never silent (E8).',
+        );
+      }
+    }
+    final seen = <String>{};
+    for (final tool in tools) {
+      if (tool.name.trim().isEmpty) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" contributes a tool with a blank id.',
+        );
+      }
+      if (!seen.add(tool.name)) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" contributes "${tool.name}" twice — the '
+          'builder rejects duplicate ids at build time (E7).',
+        );
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// The declared state for [profileName], or null when the profile is a

+/// The declared host-extension surface (issue #1079 component 4 —
+/// `HostExtensionApi`): the sanctioned way a host adds what the SDK does
+/// not have — its own tools — THROUGH the builder, with the capability
+/// matrix declared at birth.
+///
+/// A [HostExtension] is a named registrant's contribution: the tools it
+/// contributes plus an explicit state for every profile the host can
+/// wire. The builder (lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart) enforces the
+/// three extension invariants:
+///
+/// - **E6 — declared at birth**: every built-in profile MUST have an
+///   explicit state (`on` / `off(reason)`); there is no implicit default.
+///   A state for a custom profile is optional at construction but
+///   required at wire time for any profile the host actually wires.
+/// - **E7 — collisions rejected at build time**: an extension tool id
+///   colliding with the SDK core, the gated task surface, or another
+///   extension throws [HostWiringException] naming both registrants. (A
+///   tool id colliding with a CORE tool would silently override SDK
+///   behavior — the one thing this API must never do — so the loud check
+///   lives in the builder, not the replace-and-note [ToolRegistry], whose
+///   leniency is the child-pool contract, issue #862.)
+/// - **E8 — off means hidden with a reason**: on a profile whose state is
+///   `off`, the extension's tools never reach the registry and the off
+///   reason surfaces through [WiredAgentCore.extensions] for the host's
+///   UI — the hide-if-off invariant, extension edition.
+///
+/// **Additive-only (AC9/UT-5):** the type carries tools and declarations,
+/// nothing else — there is no member that could override a core behavior
+/// (memory, context management, compaction, the JSONL tool session,
+/// trajectory are SDK invariants). The only route to "replace" a core
+/// tool is a colliding id, and E7 rejects it at build time.
+///
+/// Pure Dart: no `dart:io`.
+library;
+
+import '../agent/agent_tool.dart';
+import 'host_capability_profile.dart';
+import 'host_wiring_builder.dart' show builtInProfiles;
+
+/// A host's declared extension: named tools + an explicit per-profile
+/// matrix state (E6).
+final class HostExtension {
+  /// Registrant id — E7 collision reports name both sides; keep it the
+  /// thing a host user would recognize (`cli-plugins`, `yoclip`).
+  final String name;
+
+  /// The tools contributed on profiles where the extension is `on`.
+  final List<AgentTool> tools;
+
+  /// The matrix declaration: profile name → state. Every built-in profile
+  /// (the keys of `builtInProfiles`) MUST be present — E6, no implicit
+  /// default. Extra keys are custom profiles; they are validated at wire
+  /// time (a state must exist for whatever the host actually wires).
+  final Map<String, CapabilityState> profileStates;
+
+  /// Validates and builds. Throws [HostProfileViolation] on an E6 gap
+  /// (missing built-in profile, blank reason, a transport state — tool
+  /// extensions have no transport dimension), an empty name, or an
+  /// empty/duplicate tool id.
+  HostExtension({
+    required this.name,
+    List<AgentTool> tools = const [],
+    required Map<String, CapabilityState> profileStates,
+  }) : tools = List.unmodifiable(tools),
+       profileStates = Map.unmodifiable(profileStates) {
+    if (name.trim().isEmpty) {
+      throw const HostProfileViolation(
+        'HostExtension name must not be blank (E7 names registrants — '
+        'they need a real id).',
+      );
+    }
+    final missing = builtInProfiles.keys
+        .where((profile) => !profileStates.containsKey(profile))
+        .toList();
+    if (missing.isNotEmpty) {
+      throw HostProfileViolation(
+        'HostExtension "$name" declares no state for built-in profile(s) '
+        '${missing.map((m) => '"$m"').join(', ')} — declare every built-in '
+        'profile explicitly (E6: there is no implicit default).',
+      );
+    }
+    for (final entry in profileStates.entries) {
+      if (entry.value is CapabilityTransportState) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" declares a transport state for profile '
+          '"${entry.key}" — tool extensions have no transport dimension; '
+          'declare on or off(reason).',
+        );
+      }
+      if (entry.value.reason case final reason? when reason.trim().isEmpty) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" is off on "${entry.key}" without a reason '
+          '— off is never silent (E8).',
+        );
+      }
+    }
+    final seen = <String>{};
+    for (final tool in tools) {
+      if (tool.name.trim().isEmpty) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" contributes a tool with a blank id.',
+        );
+      }
+      if (!seen.add(tool.name)) {
+        throw HostProfileViolation(
+          'HostExtension "$name" contributes "${tool.name}" twice — the '
+          'builder rejects duplicate ids at build time (E7).',
+        );
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// The declared state for [profileName], or null when the profile is a
+  /// custom one this extension does not declare (validated at wire time).
